name: Island turtle
notes: Origin at the waterline under the shell centre, head +Z, up +Y, 40 m long. Authored pose has the neck fully out and eyes open; joint value neck 0 pulls the head 7 m into the shell, blink 0 is open. Joints swim -1...1 (front flippers 32 deg with lagging tip, hind flippers 18 deg), head -1...1 (yaw 35 deg, positive toward +X), neck 0...1, rise 0...1 (body lifts 4 m), blink 0...1 are empty drivers; child parts mimic them. The water line is owned by the lens.
parts: lofted shell, 64 stations by 64 radial points, scute seam relief
moss mound on the shell with rock outcrop
three trees with bark trunks and leaf cards
leathery neck and head, lofted, glass eyes with lids
two front paddle flippers with a lagging tip segment and two hind flippers
style: Giant sea turtle in wet olive-brown plates and leathery grey-green skin, carrying a small mossy wooded island, original shapes only.
summary: 40 m island turtle: lofted scute shell with barnacles, moss mound with three trees and a rock outcrop, leathery neck and head with lids, four paddle flippers.
